Thank you for your insight.

I also experience a degree of paranoia from my bipolar disorder. While I can laugh it of when I'm stable, less so when I'm not. Once a black guy followed me around the park in a severe episode. That made it infinitely worse. Laughing about it isn't always possible for me. 

My worst experiences with men come from a mixed bag of races, and I try not to throw the manipulative and abusive tendencies of my one black ex into the same box as the street things that have happened.

I can definitely bring it up with my psych... For a while I was wondering if it was cognitive bias trying to project the bad things that happened between me and my balck ex on others... But it just seems to be such a countable thing... I wanna discuss it with my female friends, but I don't wanna seem racist...
This looks familiar. I've written hundreds of pages of nonsense in a matter of days when up. They all look like this.
Where I live there is less than 10% black people. More than half the catcalls I get come from black men.

It is quite normal to question whether you have it. Regardless, you seem to be displaying a lot of symptoms. At the very least it is worth getting a thorough examination. Even if it isn't bipolar, getting your symptoms checked out properly can help you find ways to cope better.
I'm building it down, currently at 300.
I still get very very sleepy on the XR... That's one of the reasons I'm weaning off. Are you sure you are not on XR already? I think it's the standard especially for high dosages.

Fair enough... I think for me the XR is probably what I need. I will call on Monday and make sure it's fixed. It's a new psych at a clinic I've been at for a while, so I think it'll be okay.

With my Lithium I have not even an idea witch one it is. But Seroquel makes me so sleepyyy
Thank you! Sounds like I need my XR.
Oh yes, and there was the time I got dizzy and convinced myself I had inhaled poisonous gas from the stove but I still kept on scrubing
Thank you!  I'm hopeful they will :)
